annotations.title: Base contract bytecode, proxy-slot and zero-supply heuristics

description: Limited Base contract bytecode, EIP-1967 slot and zero-supply heuristics. Missing or unsupported property reads are null; RPC transport failures return 502. Ownership renunciation requires a confirmed zero owner. Empty slots do not identify uninitialized proxies. EOAs return not-applicable. Not a full security audit; see endpoint details for coverage limits. Use before approving or calling an unfamiliar Base contract. Example: address=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
